title: Sizes of rolls of black and white and colour paper for roll paper printers
clause_1_scope: This standard specifics the sizes with their tolerances of rolls of black and white, and colour paper for roll paper printers.
clause_3_terminology: Sizes of rolls of black and white and colour paper for roll paper printers

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
